train_q_interactive_learner: train the QInteractiveLearner on an EpisodeBatch with TD-error loss and regularization
update_target_networks: update target MAC and mixer networks by copying current network weights
initialize_q_interactive_learner: initialize a QInteractiveLearner with a MAC, logger, and configurable mixer type
save_learner_models: save the MAC, mixer, and optimizer state dicts to a directory path
load_learner_models: load the MAC, mixer, and optimizer state dicts from a directory path
